title: ENS support for beaconcha.in
tagline: This feature adds support for searching domains registered via ENS. Also contains support for search ahead to predict ENS domain search.
description: Makes searching for addresses easier on beaconcha.in, and since this is the widely used ETH explorer after transitioning to POS, this solves pain point for many users.
how_its_made: Faced some issues to completely understand the existing beacocha.in open source implementation, and add support for ENS domain resolution with the least number of changes required, while also solving all use-cases.
